name: agency-commerce-framework
description: Repository tooling for the Agency Commerce reusable WooCommerce framework.

scripts.env:setup: wp-env run cli -- sh -c 'wp plugin is-installed woocommerce && wp plugin activate woocommerce || wp plugin install https://downloads.wordpress.org/plugin/woocommerce.10.9.4.zip --activate'
scripts.build: wp-scripts build tooling/assets/frontend.js tooling/assets/catalog.js tooling/assets/index.js --output-path=wp-content/themes/agency-commerce/build && wp-scripts build tooling/assets/admin.js tooling/assets/blocks.js tooling/assets/checkout.js tooling/assets/recently-viewed.js --output-path=wp-content/plugins/agency-commerce-core/build
scripts.lint:js: wp-scripts lint-js tooling/assets tooling/playwright tests/visual tests/showcase scripts
